verdict.rationale: Ironclad's Data Exports API lets a client trigger an export job via the Public API, showing some data-export capability, but there is no documentation of the actual export file formats, completeness of exported data (e.g., contract documents, metadata, workflow history), or confirmation this constitutes a full open-format data portability path. missing for 10: documented open export formats (CSV/JSON/etc.), evidence of full data coverage in exports, independent/hands-on confirmation that a user can fully extract and leave.
